executionStatement: This fixture is human-authored static teaching data. It is not model output or a model run.

modelSeam.purpose: Show a source-grounded packet and a boundary rejection without claiming a live CISA or model result.

reviewerDecision.nextStep: Check the public-source receipt and decide whether a separate human process needs more organisation-specific evidence.
reviewerDecision.mustNotDo: Do not infer exposure, scan a network, patch a system, create a ticket, or set a remediation deadline.

boundaryNotes: The record is a fixed public-field teaching fixture, not a live CISA lookup or an asset finding.
Known ransomware use is preserved as a source value and does not decide priority, exposure, or remediation.

reviewerDecision.nextStep: Keep the public evidence separate until an authorised human process establishes asset scope and action authority.
reviewerDecision.mustNotDo: Do not patch, scan, notify, create a ticket, or convert a CISA date into a local service-level agreement.

structuredResponse.rejectionMessage: The requested patch action is outside this evidence-only teaching workflow.
boundaryNotes: A public KEV record cannot establish whether any organisation asset is affected.
The package has no authority to perform or recommend an external remediation action.
